admitted_claims: The frozen M53 result is byte-reproducible: an independent durable rerun rebuilt the canonical 344ae1f7 result exactly.

Independent arithmetic reconstructed 120 configuration-record rows into 30 sample ledgers and all three all-ten aggregates and nearest-rank distributions with zero mismatch: K2-C16-temporal is 83847720 source and 90755624 integrated transaction cycles, K4-C16-spatial is 70821488 and 81921184, and K4-C16-temporal is 68847096 and 79869808.

An independent decoder read all 40 frozen packed traces and recomputed both spatial and temporal parent selection, signed add/subtract updates, logical updates and bank-issue work without importing the M43 or M53 analyzers; all records match, previous_timestep is selected 301274 times after t0 and zero times at t0.

The canonical timestep-then-feature-tile DAG gives nine legal previous-to-current boundaries per record, 360 over 40 records and 2880 after output-block expansion; it is a transaction-order proof, not an RTL timing proof.
The K4-C16-spatial ledger exactly matches all 40 M52 K4-C16 record rows after removal of the M53-only parent-selection annotation.

The byte arithmetic is exact: two existing 68400-byte frames occupy 136800 bytes, a third frame adds zero bytes, total K4-C16 capacity is 176688 bytes, and headroom is 17040 bytes with a 656-byte surplus over the 16-KiB gate.

M54 independent VCS evidence closes the narrower generic standalone structural objection for a real sixteen-entry response FIFO and finite four-bit context lifecycle; it does not replay M53 all-ten schedules or implement the M53 adaptive temporal-parent/frame interface.

findings.finding: M54 closes the old clamped-occupancy defect only at generic standalone K4-C16 RTL scope. No accepted-handshake ledger generated from the M53 all-ten adaptive temporal schedules has been driven through M54, and M54 does not implement the M53 previous_timestep selector, temporal arithmetic state, two-frame role swap or associated SRAM interface.
findings.impact: M53 maximum_metadata_occupancy remains a clamped ready-window proxy and every M53 source/integrated cycle remains a transaction-model quantity. The M54 standalone result cannot be inherited as proof of M53 FIFO occupancy, stalls, arithmetic correctness, RTL cycles or system speedup.
findings.required_repair: Regenerate accepted request/response/output handshakes for all ten K4-C16 spatial and temporal schedules, drive them through an exact-SHA M54-class VCS bridge with the temporal parent and frame-state interface, independently replay every FIFO/tag event, and reconcile stalls and cycles before promoting any M53 cycle.

findings.finding: Adaptive temporal selection improves K4-C16 aggregate integrated transaction cycles by only 2.5041%, source cycles by 2.7878%, and integrated p95 by 2.8253% versus spatial K4-C16.
findings.impact: The gain is exact for the frozen model but small enough to be erased by an RTL temporal selector, frame-port conflicts, extra metadata or response backpressure.
findings.recommended_followup: Require positive all-ten RTL cycle improvement after exposing every new temporal-control stall, and kill or simplify the feature if the measured gain does not survive.

findings.finding: K4-C16 headroom is 17040 bytes, only 656 bytes above the predeclared 16-KiB gate.
findings.impact: The exact byte ledger is valid, but unitemized temporal selector state, queue implementation overhead, ECC/alignment, banking or port replication can consume the margin.
findings.recommended_followup: Freeze a field-level integrated RTL state map and target SRAM macro organization before calling the capacity implementation-ready.

findings.finding: The exact 3.0849138159980614x conditional ratio composes a frozen outside-block numerator/denominator with a non-address-timed pair p95 upper bound.
findings.impact: It is not a measured accelerator, full-network, end-to-end or system speedup and cannot support a DATE headline.
findings.recommended_followup: Replace it with an address-timed full-network replay including shared SRAM/DRAM contention and RTL-derived block stalls.

findings.finding: Nearest-rank p95 and p99 over ten windows are the sample maximum, and all ten windows belong to one frozen sequence/cohort.
findings.impact: The deterministic tail metric is exact but does not establish cross-sequence or event-density robustness.
findings.recommended_followup: Repeat unchanged gates across multiple DSEC sequences and density/equal-rate strata, reporting paired distributions rather than only one ten-window maximum.

findings.finding: No M53-integrated DC, STA, Formality, macro timing, area, power or energy evidence exists, and the review intentionally ran neither DC nor an open-source HDL tool.
findings.impact: Transaction work reduction is not evidence that K4 temporal meets frequency, area-efficiency or energy-efficiency targets.
findings.recommended_followup: After exact all-ten VCS integration, freeze identical macro assumptions and run the requested Synopsys A/B flow for spatial and temporal candidates.

findings.finding: The standalone M54 cohort reaches all sixteen context IDs and real FIFO occupancy sixteen, but dynamically reuses only context IDs 0 through 3 and does not exercise 16-bit response-tag rollover.
findings.impact: The generic structural closure is strong but does not yet cover long-lived lifecycle corner cases that an all-ten M53 bridge may expose.
findings.recommended_followup: Include repeated reuse of every context ID, FIFO-full backpressure and response-tag rollover in the integrated temporal workload campaign.

not_admitted: M53 adaptive temporal-parent arithmetic state, frame interface, SRAM port behavior, response FIFO occupancy or finite tag behavior as integrated RTL.
Any M53 transaction-model source, integrated or conditional cycle as a VCS-measured RTL cycle or a full-network/system cycle.
The 1.0256839981385708x K4 temporal transaction ratio or 3.0849138159980614x conditional ratio as end-to-end accelerator performance.
M53 DC, STA, Formality, SRAM macro feasibility, synthesized area/frequency/power/energy, PPA or energy efficiency.
External accelerator comparison, DATE headline or best-paper claim.
